text:
Hi everyone,

I'm a bit confused about the online application! We have all our documents ready and were about to hit send, but as far as I could tell it was only possible to upload one document per field. As someone with two citizenships (and lived in a third country), where do I upload the documents from the other countries then? I know there is a field at the very end that says "Additional Documents" but you can also only upload a single one there, and I have like 7 other documents they want from me 😅

Am I overseeing something? Thank you for your help!
